summary: Iteration 66 - Sovereign Onyx Visual Refinement Testing (Stitch Mockups). All visual elements verified: Login with bypass code works, Mobile bottom nav with 5 tabs (Explore, Network, Brain, Shop, Profile), Brain golden sphere page with ripple rings and gold gradient, Settings page with Profil Public navigation to ProfilePage, Shop with editorial hero layout, Network with search panel, Feed with filter tabs. Header shows 'Kiltikonet' in serif italic with KT badge.

minor.issue: 429 Too Many Requests errors during testing due to rate limiting. Does not affect functionality.
